reference-impl/lib/prep-worktree.ts is the sole file modified (no changes to standard/ or unrelated CLI commands)

The guard is enforced at the CLI layer independently of prompt text, so no prompt change is required to activate it
Changes pass the existing reference-impl test suite; a new unit test covers the guard rejection path
acceptance_criteria: cloverleaf-cli write-ui-review-state (or the relevant baseline-write command) exits with a non-zero code and a descriptive error when baselines_pending is true in the task's ui-review state (RFC AC #9)
